title: Prepared configuration after evaluation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $\mathrm{emit}$ be a Boolean, let $x$, $\mathrm{arg}$, and $\mathrm{cap}$ be Boolean words, and let $T\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose the run of $M$ on $\mathrm{arg}$ has output $\mathrm{cap}$ at time $T$. The embedded evaluator configuration formed from the right-boundary scan of the tracked run at time $T$, with the scan halted at the right end of $\mathrm{arg}$, equals the call-layout frame with zero cleared banks, state at the source evaluator's return state, data tapes from the run at time $T$, visited-span and origin-marker tapes, argument and capture contents, and corresponding head positions.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
the output of $M$ on $\mathrm{arg}$ at time $T$ equals $\mathrm{cap}$
replaced:
Let the source run on argument $a$ have output $c$ at time $T$. The identity relocation
of the evaluator configuration of the halted right-normalized tracked endpoint equals
the cleanup frame with zero cleaned banks: complete source data, visited spans, origin
markers, captured result $c$, and the argument head at its right boundary.
